data.notes: Stock synthetic voices; ASR-reviewed transcripts and word alignments. No held-out speech input admitted.

architecture: Cache embeddings and first 28 frozen temporal blocks; unload prefix; train last4 temporal blocks and text head adapters with native text/audio objective. Original names exported for full-model streaming.
selection: Validation-loss-selected checkpoint is only a candidate; native speech/character/interruption review required. Compare same six frozen audio probes and sampling seed to baseline.
runtime: All on M2 8GB. Pin at the device-recommended wired memory limit, following observed paging slowdown without pinning. Report actual model/codec times separately.
implementation_checks: Tiny causal/streaming and cached/full loss-gradient parity already passed; these are not trained speech benchmarks.
risks: Limited voice diversity and overlap examples
